articles.title: Niamey charts a path towards improved urban resilience
articles.description: The City of Niamey and UNDRR organized a capacity-building assessment on disaster risk reduction from 8 to 10 August 2026, as part of MCR2030.

articles.title: National Indigenous Disaster Resilience, Monash University
articles.description: NIDR is a research program within the Faculty of Arts, Monash University. Established in 2022, NIDR is Australia’s only Indigenous-led, nationally focused program investigating how major disasters affect Indigenous people, communities and organizations.

articles.title: Let’s take charge of resilience. By working together we can be tsunami ready says UN Secretary-General António Guterres
articles.description: On this World Tsunami Awareness Day, let’s take charge of resilience. By working together we can be tsunami ready – and save lives whenever the waves strike.

articles.title: Concept note: World Tsunami Awareness Day 2026
articles.description: The theme of World Tsunami Awareness Day 2026, on 5 November, is “Be Tsunami Ready: Resilience Starts With You”. It builds on WTAD 2025’s emphasis on investment in preparedness by focusing on individual and community action.

articles.title: Resilience, Adaptation and Inclusion in Nepal
articles.description: RAIN is an FCDO-funded programme supporting Nepal’s climate adaptation, mitigation, disaster risk management, and shock-responsive social protection. RAIN TA SLU is implemented by a consortium led by Mott MacDonald.

articles.title: UNDRR advances climate resilience, early warning systems, and risk-informed water management at Cairo Water Week 2026
articles.description: At Cairo Water Week 2026, UNDRR promoted risk-informed water management, early warning systems, and climate resilience through regional cooperation.

articles.title: SubToculUsii
articles.description: SubToculUsii is a Romanian online platform offering emergency kits and preparedness products. They develop awareness, prevention, and disaster risk reduction initiatives, working with partners from the public, private and civil society sectors.

articles.title: Capacity Building Workshop on Financing Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR)
articles.description: The Capacity Building Workshop on Financing Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) equips government officials and experts with practical tools to assess financing needs, identify investment gaps, mobilize resources, and develop national DRR financing strategies.

articles.title: Putting risk communication at the heart of disaster preparedness
articles.description: UNDRR, UNESCO and IFRC brought experts together in Geneva to explore how to overcome barriers to effective risk communication and turn disaster warnings into informed, life-saving action.

articles.title: Geneva students take disaster preparedness home
articles.description: A hands-on experience of disaster risk reduction helps equip the next generation for a resilient future.

articles.title: Statement of the Second Arab Regional Forum for early warning systems and disaster preparedness: Arab call to action to strengthen early warning systems
articles.description: The Arab Call to Action outlines regional priorities to strengthen inclusive early warning systems, disaster preparedness, anticipatory action and cooperation across the Arab region.
